citations.quote: What will the point difference be?

This market resolves to Yes if the score differential recorded in favor of San Antonio in the entire NBA game between Los Angeles C and San Antonio scheduled for 2026-11-19 at 7:00 p.m. CT is above 8.5. Otherwise, it resolves to No. The Underlying is the score differential (San Antonio's score minus Los Angeles C's score) for the specified game. Source Agencies, in order, are the league governing the event (NBA), ESPN, Fox Sports, and the official broadcast partner of the event.
